author: marioevz
content:
Hey <@372731338031366165> I've created https://github.com/MysticRyuujin/hive/pull/2 to your branch to fix this issue.

The culprit was EIP-7997 handling by geth at the fork boundary. This should be gone by Devnet-8 spec, but prior to this, if the contract was absent, Geth would put it in the state at the beginning of the first Amsterdam block, and this diverges from all other client implementations, and this was the difference you were seeing in the BlockLevelAccess list.

The spec tests nor devnets ran into this issue because they placed the contract directly in genesis, so at the time of the fork, geth did not modify the state and was in agreement with other clients.

This PR places the contract in the genesis to side-step this issue in Devnet-7 implementation of geth (again, gone by Devnet-8 hopefully and we do include a test for this now already).

I've verified that nethermind, erigon, reth, and besu process the block correctly without issues.

author: marioevz

I will however still consider this bit of the issue you created and add tests in the specs:

This is a true gap and we will address it 🙌
